title: Apparently CodePen 2.0 sends data to their servers as you type
summary: A security researcher discovered that CodePen 2.0 transmits user input to their servers in near real-time (1-2 seconds) as you type, even before saving. Testing with a unique marker confirmed that typed content appears verbatim in network requests to codepen.dev, raising concerns about accidental secret exposure.
problem_solved: Reveals a privacy/security issue where CodePen's live preview system may inadvertently transmit sensitive data like API keys or secrets to third-party servers without explicit user consent.
why_valuable: Highlights an important security concern for developers who may accidentally type secrets into online code editors, potentially exposing credentials to unauthorized servers.
